create_PodLockManager: create a PodLockManager instance to manage distributed Redis locks for cron jobs across pods
get_redis_lock_key_PodLockManager: get_redis_lock_key builds a Redis lock key string from a cronjob_id for pod lock management
acquire_lock_PodLockManager: acquire_lock attempts to acquire a Redis lock for a cronjob_id with optional TTL across distributed pods
release_lock_PodLockManager: release_lock releases a Redis lock for a cronjob_id using atomic compare-and-delete to prevent races
compare_and_delete_lock_PodLockManager: compare_and_delete_lock atomically deletes a Redis lock key only if the current pod owns it
